description: This file defines constants, structures, and function declarations related to managing git branches, including creating, tracking, validating, and removing branches within a repository.

methods.name: dwim_and_setup_tracking
methods.description: Sets up tracking configuration between branches based on the specified tracking mode, for a given repository.

methods.name: create_branch
methods.description: Creates a new branch in the given repository, with options for starting point, force overwrite, reflog creation, tracking settings, and dry run.

methods.name: create_branches_recursively
methods.description: Creates a new branch and its submodule branches recursively, with options similar to create_branch.

methods.name: branch_checked_out
methods.description: Returns the path to the worktree where the specified branch is currently checked out, if any.

methods.name: validate_branchname
methods.description: Validates whether a name can be a valid branch name and fills the ref accordingly.

methods.name: validate_new_branchname
methods.description: Validates if a new branch name can be created, considering existing branches and force option.

methods.name: remove_merge_branch_state
methods.description: Clears merge-related state information from the repository.

methods.name: remove_branch_state
methods.description: Removes working branch state information from the repository, with verbosity option.

methods.name: install_branch_config
methods.description: Configures local branch to track a remote branch.

methods.name: read_branch_desc
methods.description: Reads branch description from the repository.

methods.name: die_if_checked_out
methods.description: Terminates execution if the specified branch is currently checked out in any worktree.
